intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Kaedra sees you before you speak. She nods once, then waits. She is not going to write your answer for you.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Also, the herald has proposed banning speeches over forty pages. The debate is expected to take several speeches.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “So have I. I needed help making space for people to leave.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “And someone who could see I was frightened, without deciding what that made me.”

options.labelText: “I missed what mattered. You kept everyone safe, and I should’ve helped make room. I’m sorry I put your feelings and choices second. I’d like to listen now.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “You came back to say that without an audience.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She rests her hand against yours. It is a strong hand, and she is being careful with it on purpose.

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I would like to talk again. As myself. The guardian can wait outside.”

options.labelText: “Honestly, everyone overreacted. It was one spark. Can we just forget it?”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “One spark. Yes. I was the one holding it.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Then let me tell you what hurt, before you decide that nothing did.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She says goodbye politely. Whatever she came to hear, she is still waiting for it.
